parts.text:
Assign an L1 regularization penalty factor (LLM-Lasso protocol) to each supplied baseline measurement using only the measurement descriptions and task description (no patient records or labels). Use an integer from 1 to 5: 1 = highly predictive (minimal penalty), 2 = moderately predictive, 3 = uncertain/weak, 4 = unlikely useful, 5 = irrelevant (maximum penalty). Return strict JSON with the single top-level key "penalties" mapping every supplied field ID to its integer penalty in {1,2,3,4,5}.
{"task": "At this HIV clinic visit, assess bleeding vulnerability and issues obtaining intravenous access for a procedure.", "fields": {"F4": {"description": "History of hemophilia", "name": "hemophil"}, "F5": {"description": "Karnofsky functional status score", "name": "karnof"}, "F3": {"description": "History of injection drug use", "name": "ivdrug"}, "F2": {"description": "Recorded race or ethnicity category", "name": "raceth"}, "F7": {"description": "Duration of previous zidovudine use in months", "name": "priorzdv"}, "F0": {"description": "Assigned treatment includes indinavir", "name": "tx"}, "F8": {"description": "Age in years", "name": "age"}, "F6": {"description": "Baseline CD4 cell count", "name": "cd4"}, "F1": {"description": "Recorded sex", "name": "sex"}}}
